//: Source of truth for the picture library: every puzzle picture, its album, lookalike family, size in cells and the prompt it was generated from. tools/art/pictures.py builds public/pictures/** and src/content/pictures.json from this and the masters in tools/art/masters/. Pictures are NOT drawn in the game's chosen look (AGENTS.md rulings): each is a photograph or a painting in its own medium.
//cell: One card, w x h px: cards are portrait 3:4 (creator, 2026-10-24). The first 60 pictures were made for square 384 px cells and are centre-cropped by the game.

pictures.title: Harbour at Dusk
pictures.prompt: An impressionist oil painting of a Mediterranean harbour town at sunset. Pastel houses and a tall stone bell tower line the waterfront across the middle of the picture; small fishing boats and sailboats are moored in the calm water across the foreground; the setting sun sits low over distant hills, laying long golden reflections across the rippled water. Thick visible brush strokes and canvas texture.

pictures.title: Dunes at Sundown
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic wide panoramic photograph of a Sahara desert camp at sunset: a camel caravan with riders in robes crossing the foreground along a dune ridge, their long shadows on rippled sand; dry shrubs, rocks and footprints; a palm oasis with low tents, rugs and a glowing lantern in the middle distance; layered dune crests catching orange light beside deep violet shadows; a hazy peach and coral sky with a low sun and wispy clouds near the horizon.

pictures.title: Poppies at Sunset
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a field of red-orange poppies at sunset, backlit so the petals glow: many poppies at different distances filling the frame, buds, seed heads and grasses between them, a few blue cornflowers, soft distant hills and a narrow band of peach-gold sky near the top.

pictures.title: Oranges by Candlelight
pictures.prompt: A Dutch Golden Age style oil still life lit by candlelight: a brass candlestick with a lit candle, a pewter plate of oranges and apricots, one orange half-peeled with its peel curling over the table edge, a copper jug, a loaf of bread, a glass of amber wine, walnuts and a rumpled peach-coloured cloth on a wooden table. Behind them, a warm plastered wall and an open window showing an orange sunset sky over rooftops, so the background is full of detail rather than dark. Fine glazed brushwork.

pictures.title: Blossom Lane
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a narrow stone-paved lane in Kyoto in spring: traditional wooden houses with tiled roofs and round paper lanterns on both sides, cherry trees in full pink bloom arching overhead, fallen petals on the paving stones, a five-storey pagoda rising at the far end of the lane, a few small distant people walking.

pictures.title: Peonies in a Jug
pictures.prompt: A watercolour painting of a lavish bouquet of pink and blush peonies, some fully open and some in bud, with green leaves, in a cream ceramic jug on a table with a lace cloth; scattered petals; a window with soft pink curtains and a garden beyond. Loose wet-in-wet washes, granulating pigment, visible paper grain and crisp painted edges.

pictures.title: Strawberry Layer Cake
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic food photograph from a three-quarter angle: a pink layered sponge cake with cream, topped with strawberries and raspberries; pink macarons stacked beside it; a bowl of strawberries; rose petals and mint leaves scattered on a pale pink marble table; a teacup with a pink rose pattern.

pictures.title: The Rose Hat
pictures.prompt: An impressionist oil painting of a young woman in a wide straw hat trimmed with pink roses and a cream lace blouse, seen from the side as she looks over her shoulder, standing in a garden of blooming pink rose bushes with a stone path and an arched rose trellis behind her. Soft dappled light. Thick visible brush strokes.

pictures.title: Maple Path
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a forest path in peak autumn: a winding gravel path covered in fallen leaves, maple and beech trees in rust, amber, red and ochre leaves on both sides and overhead, a small wooden footbridge over a stream midway along the path, soft sunbeams through the canopy.

pictures.title: Harvest Table
pictures.prompt: A rich oil painting still life of an autumn harvest on a long rustic wooden table: orange pumpkins and squashes, red apples, golden pears, bunches of dark grapes, a wicker basket of chestnuts, maple leaves scattered over the table, a copper pot and a stoneware jug of cider; behind them, a window opening onto trees in autumn colour. Visible brush strokes.

pictures.title: The Apple Picker
pictures.prompt: A gouache illustration of a smiling grandmother in a rust-coloured knitted shawl and a headscarf, holding a wicker basket full of red apples in an autumn orchard: apple trees with red fruit and amber leaves around her, a wooden ladder against a tree, fallen apples in the grass, a farm cart behind. Matte opaque gouache with visible brush marks.

pictures.title: Ivy Lane
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic tall vertical photograph of a narrow cobbled lane between old red-brick townhouses whose walls are covered in Boston ivy turned rust red and amber, white-framed windows with flower boxes, an old iron street lamp, fallen leaves on the cobbles, a church spire glimpsed at the far end.

pictures.title: Blue Domes
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a whitewashed Santorini village: blue-domed churches, a bell tower, white cube houses and stairways stepping down the cliff, pots of flowers, and in the lower third the deep blue Aegean sea with ripples, a small white boat and the caldera islands beyond; bright clear light.

pictures.title: Lighthouse Surf
pictures.prompt: An oil painting of a rocky coastline with crashing turquoise and cobalt waves, white foam and spray over dark rocks, a white lighthouse on a grassy headland in the middle distance, seabirds, and a blue sky with billowing white clouds. Bold palette-knife and brush strokes.

pictures.title: Blue Hydrangeas
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a garden full of blue and periwinkle hydrangea blooms, dozens of flower heads filling the frame at different distances, dew drops on the petals and green leaves, a white picket fence and a blue cottage door partly visible behind.

pictures.title: The Net Mender
pictures.prompt: A watercolour painting of an old fisherman in a navy sweater and cap sitting on a harbour quay mending a blue fishing net, with wooden crates, coiled ropes and floats around him, blue and white fishing boats on the water behind, and white houses on the far shore. Loose watercolour washes on textured paper.

pictures.title: Wheat and Cypress
pictures.prompt: A post-impressionist impasto oil painting of golden wheat fields in summer: swirling wheat in the foreground with a few red poppies, a winding dirt road, a farmhouse with a red roof and haystacks in the middle distance, a row of dark cypress trees, and a lively sky of blue with swirling white clouds in the upper part. Thick textured brush strokes.

pictures.title: Baker's Table
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic wide panoramic food photograph of a rustic bakery table: crusty sourdough loaves, baguettes, a braided loaf and rolls dusted with flour, sheaves of golden wheat, a linen cloth, a bowl of honey with a wooden dipper, scattered grain on a wooden board, warm golden morning light.

pictures.title: Sunflowers
pictures.prompt: A tall vertical oil painting of tall sunflowers in a blue-and-white ceramic vase on a wooden table, large golden flower heads at several heights up the full height of the picture, leaves and buds, a straw-coloured wall and a sunny window behind. Expressive, textured brush strokes.

pictures.title: Summer Walk
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a young girl in a straw hat and a cream summer dress walking through a golden wheat field at golden hour, seen from the side, her hand brushing the wheat ears; a line of trees and a farmhouse on the horizon in the upper part and a warm low sun. The lower part of the picture is full of distinct things among the wheat: on the left a weathered wooden fence post with a wicker basket of picked wildflowers hanging from it, on the right blue cornflowers, white daisies and red poppies, and a butterfly.

pictures.title: Lavender Rows
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of Provence lavender fields: long converging rows of purple lavender in the foreground with bees on the flowers, an old stone farmhouse with a terracotta roof and a lone tree in the middle distance, rolling hills and a band of soft evening sky.

pictures.title: Wisteria Door
pictures.prompt: A watercolour painting of an old stone cottage front draped in cascading purple wisteria, a weathered sage-green door with an iron knocker, a shuttered window, pots of lavender and violets on the steps, a bicycle leaning on the wall, and cobblestones. Delicate washes, fine pen-free brushwork, visible paper grain.

pictures.title: Lilacs
pictures.prompt: An oil painting of an abundant bouquet of purple, violet and pale mauve lilacs in a glass vase on a table, sprigs and petals scattered, an open book and a teacup beside it, and a softly patterned lilac-grey wallpaper behind. Painterly brush strokes.

pictures.title: Figs and Grapes
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic food photograph of purple figs, some cut open, bunches of purple grapes, plums and blackberries on a slate board with lavender sprigs, a wedge of soft cheese, a little pot of honey and a lavender-grey linen napkin.

pictures.title: Tea Terraces
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of terraced tea plantations on rolling hills: curving rows of emerald tea bushes in the foreground, tea pickers in wide hats small in the middle distance, a winding path, tall trees and misty green hills behind, and a narrow band of soft sky at the top.

pictures.title: Market Greens
pictures.prompt: A gouache illustration of a farmers' market stall of green produce seen from above at an angle: wooden crates of peas in their pods, courgettes, broccoli, artichokes and cucumbers, bunches of basil and parsley, limes and green apples, a woven basket and a striped awning edge. Matte opaque gouache with visible brush marks.

pictures.title: The Greenhouse
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a smiling woman gardener in a green apron repotting a plant in a lush glass greenhouse, surrounded by ferns, monsteras, hanging trailing plants and trays of seedlings, terracotta pots and a watering can; soft daylight.

pictures.title: Green Shutters
pictures.prompt: A tall vertical oil painting of a narrow Italian alley: ochre and cream houses with green shutters, potted plants and climbing vines, laundry hanging across the alley, stone steps leading up, a cat sitting on a step, and a sliver of sky at the top. Warm painterly brushwork.

pictures.title: Canal Lights
pictures.prompt: An oil painting of a Venetian canal at blue hour: gondolas moored beside striped poles, old palazzos with warm lit windows reflected as golden streaks in the deep blue water, an arched stone bridge, street lamps glowing amber, and a deep blue and indigo evening sky with the first stars. Rich visible brushwork.

pictures.title: Night Market
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of an evening street food market at blue hour: rows of red and amber paper lanterns strung overhead, stalls with steaming bamboo baskets of dumplings, skewers on a glowing grill and bowls of noodles in the foreground, small crowds further back, and a deep blue sky. No writing anywhere.

pictures.title: The Lantern Walk
pictures.prompt: A watercolour painting of a child in a warm knitted scarf holding a glowing paper lantern on a stick, standing on a village path at blue hour, with more glowing lanterns hung from trees and fences, fireflies, and cottages with lit windows behind. Soft layered washes on textured paper.

pictures.title: Lakeside Evening
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic wide panoramic photograph of a lakeside alpine village at blue hour: houses and a church with warm glowing windows along the shore, their lights reflected in the still lake, pine forests and mountains behind under a deep blue sky with a thin moon, and a wooden jetty with a rowing boat in the foreground.

pictures.title: Cherries
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic food photograph of a white enamel bowl overflowing with glossy red cherries with stems, cherries spilling across a red-and-white checked tablecloth, a cherry pie with a lattice crust, a jug of cream and a few green cherry leaves.

pictures.title: Tulip Fields
pictures.prompt: An impressionist oil painting of Dutch tulip fields: rows of red, crimson and white tulips converging towards a windmill and a farmhouse in the middle distance, a canal with a small boat, poplar trees, and a blue sky with clouds in the upper part. Visible brush strokes.

pictures.title: The Red Tram
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic tall vertical photograph of a vintage red-and-cream tram climbing a steep narrow street in Lisbon: tiled house facades, wrought-iron balconies with red geraniums, a red awning, cobbles and tram rails, and a slice of blue sky at the top. No writing on the tram or the buildings.

pictures.title: The Red Umbrella
pictures.prompt: An oil painting of a woman in a red coat holding a red umbrella, walking along a rainy Paris street: wet cobblestones reflecting red awnings and lights, a flower stall with red roses, café tables, Haussmann buildings, and other people with umbrellas further back. Painterly palette-knife strokes. No writing on the awnings.

pictures.title: Lemon Coast
pictures.prompt: A watercolour painting of the Amalfi coast seen from a terrace under a pergola hung with lemon branches heavy with yellow lemons: pastel cliffside village houses, a church dome of yellow and green tiles, the turquoise sea with small boats below, and terracotta pots of white flowers on the terrace in the foreground. Bright washes on textured paper.

pictures.title: Lemon Tart
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic food photograph of a lemon meringue tart with toasted peaks and one slice cut out, fresh lemons whole and halved with leaves, lemon slices, a glass jug of lemonade with ice and mint, and a yellow-and-white striped napkin on a white wooden table in bright sunlight.

pictures.title: Daffodil Meadow
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a spring meadow full of yellow daffodils and white narcissus under blossoming white fruit trees, an old dry-stone wall and a white farm cottage in the middle distance, green hills, and a small band of pale sky.

pictures.title: Canal Colours
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of a young woman in a white sundress and a yellow cardigan walking a vintage bicycle with a basket of yellow tulips and lemons along a canal street of brightly painted houses in yellow, white and turquoise, with flower pots, laundry lines and small boats moored in the canal.

pictures.title: Alpine Chalets
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic photograph of an Alpine mountain village in fresh snow on a clear winter morning: old dark-timbered wooden chalets with deep snow on their roofs, carved wooden balconies, green and red painted shutters, stacked firewood under the eaves and icicles along the gutters, climbing a slope in tiers across the middle of the picture, with a slender white church tower with an onion dome among them; snow-laden fir trees between the houses; a snowy lane with a wooden sled and footprints and a stone fountain capped with snow in the foreground; snowy peaks against a pale blue sky in the top part. No festive decorations. No people, no animals, no birds.

pictures.title: Skating Day
pictures.prompt: A Dutch Golden Age oil painting of a winter landscape in the manner of Hendrick Avercamp: a busy frozen river beside a small brick town on a pale winter day, crowded with many small figures spread evenly over the whole canvas: skaters in red, grey and blue coats and scarves, children pushing a wooden chair sled, a couple skating arm in arm, people playing a stick-and-ball game, someone who has fallen over, a canvas tent stall selling hot drinks, a sledge, bare trees and a windmill on the bank, brick houses with stepped gables and snowy roofs, rowing boats frozen in along the shore; a soft pale grey-blue sky only in the top strip. Fine detail, thin glazes, small brush strokes. No animals, no horses, no dogs, no birds.

pictures.title: Frosted Hellebores
pictures.prompt: A photorealistic close photograph of a winter garden bed after a hard frost: clusters of white and pale green hellebore flowers with frost-edged petals and yellow stamens, nodding white snowdrops, sprigs of silver-blue frosted foliage, red rosehips on bare twigs, a light dusting of snow on dark leaves and moss, ice crystals sparkling on every edge; flowers at different depths filling the whole frame, all in focus.

pictures.title: Winter Stream
pictures.prompt: A watercolour painting of a winding mountain stream in deep snow, in a tall narrow view: in the foreground, icy rocks capped with snow and dark water with ice along its edges; a small wooden footbridge with snowy rails crossing the stream in the lower middle; snow-laden fir and spruce trees on both banks; further up, a log cabin with a red door and smoke from its chimney; at the top, snowy mountain peaks under a pale blue sky. pictures.prompt: A soft oil painting with thick palette-knife texture and loose, confident brushwork, warm and luminous, in warm cream and pastel tones: a playful moment: a girl in red wellies jumping into a big pile of autumn leaves, laughing toward us, leaves flying at the upper right; a rake leaning on a tree at the upper left, the leaf pile at the bottom and a small dog leaping beside her at the lower right.

Skin, hair and features drawn with care and true to life, with natural warm tones and highlights.

//destinations: A trip's postcards (lead, 2026-10-25): one real place a board, a picture the size of the whole board (4x4 or 4x5 cards). crop is the col,row of the top-left card of the 2x2 that plays on the board as an ordinary square picture; Levels' maker copies it into the board. name and place are what players read when it unfolds. docs/destinations-america.md lists the candidates.

destinations.name: Grand Canyon
destinations.checked: against Commons photos of the South Rim near Lipan Point: layered red buttes over the Colorado River's bend, its sandy, green-edged banks, warm low sun
destinations.prompt: The Grand Canyon in Arizona, seen from the South Rim in warm late-afternoon light. In the lower half of the picture, close to the viewer, a great red-orange butte of layered rock bands, its stepped cliffs lit gold with deep blue-purple shadows, and beside it a bend of the green Colorado River far below. Behind it, ridge after ridge of layered canyon walls fading into soft blue haze, under a clear pale blue sky with a few small clouds.

destinations.name: Statue of Liberty
destinations.prompt: The Statue of Liberty in New York Harbor, seen from below and a little to one side on a clear day: the green copper statue large and filling most of the picture, the golden torch held high in her raised right hand, the spiked crown and calm face, the tablet in her left arm, the deep folds of her robe, standing on the top of her grey granite pedestal; a deep blue sky with a few white clouds.

destinations.name: Niagara Falls
destinations.prompt: Niagara Falls: the great curve of the Horseshoe Falls seen from the river below, white water thundering over the green-edged brink into a tall cloud of mist, a bright rainbow arching across the spray, the deep green-blue river swirling in front, a summer blue sky. No boats.

destinations.name: Letchworth State Park
destinations.prompt: The Upper Falls of the Genesee River at Letchworth State Park, New York: a wide waterfall pouring over a stepped rock ledge into a gorge, a tall steel arch railway bridge (one deep steel arch with the deck on top) spanning the gorge high above the falls, steep green wooded cliffs of layered grey shale on both sides, summer, blue sky.

destinations.name: Lucy the Elephant
destinations.prompt: Lucy the Elephant in Margate, New Jersey, seen from the front and side, large and filling the picture: a six-storey building shaped like a standing grey elephant, made of wood and tin, with white tusks, a raised curling trunk, big ears and small windows in its body, a red blanket with gold trim on its back and an ornate canopied howdah on top, on a sandy lot by the beach under a clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Mabry Mill
destinations.prompt: An oil painting in the manner of an American plein-air painter: Mabry Mill on the Blue Ridge Parkway in Virginia, a small weathered grey-brown wooden gristmill with a big wooden overshot water wheel fed by a long raised wooden flume, reflected in a still millpond, autumn maples in red, orange and gold around it, soft afternoon light.

destinations.name: Castillo de San Marcos
destinations.prompt: Castillo de San Marcos in St. Augustine, Florida: a corner of the old Spanish star-shaped fort of grey coquina shell-stone, a sharp diamond-shaped bastion with a small round stone sentry box with a domed top on its point, seen from the grassy moat below, the thick sloping walls with rough shell-stone texture, palm trees and the blue water of Matanzas Bay beside it, a clear blue sky. No flags.

destinations.name: French Quarter
destinations.prompt: An impressionist oil painting with lively broken brushstrokes: a street corner in the French Quarter of New Orleans, two pastel townhouses with deep black wrought-iron lace balconies dripping with ferns, hanging baskets and red bougainvillea, tall green shutters, a gas lamp, a few small figures strolling far below, warm afternoon light. No signs.

destinations.name: World's Largest Ball of Twine
destinations.prompt: The world's largest ball of twine in Cawker City, Kansas: a giant round ball of tan sisal twine about eight feet across, large and filling the lower picture, its tightly wound strands clearly visible, sitting on a concrete floor under a small open-sided pavilion with a wooden roof on white posts, a small-town street and a big blue prairie sky behind. No signs, no people.

destinations.name: Paul Bunyan & Babe
destinations.prompt: The giant statues of Paul Bunyan and Babe the Blue Ox in Bemidji, Minnesota, by the lake, large and filling the picture: Paul stands tall on the left, a lumberjack with black hair, a black moustache, a red-and-black buffalo-plaid shirt, blue jeans and black boots, arms at his sides; Babe, a big bright-blue ox with white horns, stands on the right; tall pine trees and the blue lake behind, under a pale sky.

destinations.name: Pictured Rocks
destinations.prompt: Miners Castle at Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore, Michigan: a pale sandstone headland with a single castle-like turret standing out from the cliff over the clear turquoise and green water of Lake Superior, streaks of cream, orange and tan in the rock, dark pine forest on top, a bright summer sky.

destinations.name: Grand Prismatic Spring
destinations.prompt: Grand Prismatic Spring in Yellowstone National Park, seen from the air: a huge round hot spring filling most of the picture, its centre deep blue, ringed by pale green and yellow, then broad bands of orange and rusty red with fine streaks radiating outward across the pale grey mineral ground, a soft drift of steam over one side, a thin boardwalk along the edge. True, natural colours, never neon.

destinations.name: Delicate Arch
destinations.prompt: Delicate Arch in Arches National Park, Utah: a lone free-standing red-orange sandstone arch, large and filling the picture, standing on the rim of a sweeping bowl of bare pink slickrock, the snowy La Sal Mountains blue on the horizon through and beside it, a warm evening sky.

destinations.name: Yosemite Valley
destinations.prompt: Yosemite Valley from Tunnel View, California: the sheer granite face of El Capitan large on the left, Half Dome in the distance at the centre, the white plume of Bridalveil Fall on the cliff on the right, the deep green forest of the valley floor below, a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, late spring.

destinations.name: Nā Pali Coast
destinations.prompt: The Nā Pali Coast on Kauaʻi, Hawaii, seen from the sea: towering green cliffs with sharp fluted ridges dropping straight into the deep blue Pacific, white surf at their feet, a small curve of golden beach, soft white clouds clinging to the peaks.

destinations.checked: the master is mirrored: it came out with the pagoda on the left, and from the Chureito viewpoint Fuji stands left of the pagoda (Commons photos); the prompt now says so
destinations.name: Mount Fuji
destinations.prompt: Mount Fuji seen from the hillside of Arakura Sengen Shrine in Fujiyoshida, Japan, in spring: the five-storey Chureito Pagoda with red-lacquered railings and dark curved roofs in the foreground on the right, framed by pink cherry blossoms, and behind it on the left the snow-capped cone of Mount Fuji, large against a clear blue sky, the town below in soft haze.

destinations.name: Lucky Cat Temple
destinations.prompt: The beckoning cats of Gōtoku-ji temple in Tokyo: one large white maneki-neko cat figurine in the front left, raising its right paw, with a red collar and a small golden bell, and behind it hundreds of smaller white beckoning cats in many sizes packed in rows on wooden shelves against the dark wooden wall of a temple building, green maple leaves above, soft daylight. The figurines are plain white with red and gold details and no writing.

destinations.name: Great Buddha of Kamakura
destinations.prompt: The Great Buddha of Kamakura at Kōtoku-in: the huge seated bronze Buddha, weathered to a soft blue-green with streaks of dark bronze, tightly curled hair, long earlobes, eyes calmly downcast, hands resting in the lap in meditation, seated on a grey stone base in the open air, seen from the front and a little below, large and filling the picture, green trees and a blue sky behind.

destinations.name: Snow Monkey Park
destinations.prompt: Japanese macaques at the Jigokudani hot spring in winter: one red-faced snow monkey with thick grey-brown fur and snowflakes on its head sitting in the steaming water with its eyes closed, large in the foreground, two more grooming each other on the snowy rocks at the pool's edge behind it, dark cedar forest beyond, soft falling snow.

destinations.name: Shirakawa-gō
destinations.prompt: The village of Shirakawa-gō in winter at dusk: three tall gasshō-zukuri farmhouses with steep triangular thatched roofs deep in snow, warm yellow light glowing in their small windows, snowy rice fields in front, dark cedar-covered mountains behind under a deep blue evening sky.

destinations.name: Golden Pavilion
destinations.prompt: Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion in Kyoto, seen across its pond: the three-storey pavilion with its upper two floors covered in gleaming gold leaf and its ground floor of plain dark wood with white panels, dark curved shingle roofs and a small golden phoenix on the peak, standing at the water's edge, reflected in the still Kyōko-chi pond below, small pine-covered islands and rocks in the pond, green pines and maples behind, clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
destinations.prompt: The tunnel of torii gates at Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, seen from inside: hundreds of bright vermilion wooden torii with black bases and black top beams, set so close together they form a long glowing corridor curving uphill into green forest, dappled sunlight falling across the stone path. The pillars are plain, with no writing on them.

destinations.name: Kiyomizu-dera
destinations.prompt: Kiyomizu-dera in Kyoto in autumn: the temple's great wooden main hall with its broad grey cypress-bark roof and the wide wooden stage jutting out from the hillside on a tall lattice of wooden pillars, seen from the side across a valley of blazing red and orange maples, the vermilion three-storey Koyasu pagoda on the wooded hill behind, clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Nachi Falls
destinations.prompt: Nachi Falls in Wakayama, Japan: a single tall white waterfall plunging down a sheer dark cliff in deep green cedar forest, and in front of it on the left the vermilion three-storey pagoda of Seiganto-ji with dark curved roofs, the pagoda and the falls together filling the picture.

destinations.name: Himeji Castle
destinations.prompt: Himeji Castle in Japan: the great white keep rising in tiers of white plastered walls and grey tiled roofs with curving gables, standing on its high sloping stone base, large and filling the picture, pink clouds of cherry blossom at its foot, a pale blue spring sky.

destinations.name: Rabbit Island
destinations.prompt: Wild rabbits on Ōkunoshima, the rabbit island in Japan's Inland Sea: a fluffy brown rabbit sitting up on its hind legs on short green grass, large and close in the foreground, more rabbits of brown, grey and white nibbling the lawn behind it, a pine tree and the calm blue sea with small green islands beyond, a sunny day.

destinations.name: Itsukushima Shrine
destinations.prompt: The great vermilion O-torii gate of Itsukushima Shrine standing in the sea off Miyajima at high tide: its two thick main pillars braced by four smaller legs, the black curved top beam, large and filling the picture, calm blue water reflecting it, green forested Mount Misen behind, a soft evening sky. The plaque on the gate is blank.

destinations.name: Kintai Bridge
destinations.prompt: Kintai Bridge in Iwakuni, Japan: five graceful wooden arches in a row across the wide, clear Nishiki River on tall stone piers, in the lower half of the picture, cherry trees in bloom along the far bank, and the small white Iwakuni Castle on top of the green wooded mountain behind, blue sky.

destinations.name: Takachiho Gorge
destinations.prompt: Takachiho Gorge in Miyazaki, Japan, seen from the river: the slender white Manai Falls dropping from the top of a narrow gorge of dark basalt columns overhung with bright green trees, into a still jade-green river where a few small empty wooden rowboats float, summer light.

destinations.name: Taketomi Island
destinations.prompt: Taketomi Island in Okinawa: a water buffalo harnessed to a little wooden cart with a red-tiled roof, standing on a lane of white coral sand between low walls of grey coral stones topped with red and pink bougainvillea and hibiscus, traditional one-storey houses with red clay tile roofs behind, a small shisa lion figure on one roof, blue sky. The cart is empty.

destinations.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo
destinations.prompt: The Tre Cime di Lavaredo in the Dolomites, seen from the north at golden hour: three enormous pale grey rock towers standing side by side, the middle one the tallest, rising above a scree slope and green alpine meadows with a small path, a clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Seceda
destinations.prompt: The Seceda ridge above Val Gardena in the Dolomites: a vast green grassy slope rising to a sharp knife-edge of jagged grey rock spires that drops away sheer on the far side, a small wooden hay hut on the meadow, a blue sky with a few white clouds.

destinations.name: Lake Como
destinations.prompt: The village of Varenna on Lake Como: tall ochre, rose and terracotta houses with green shutters stepping down to the deep blue lake, a slender bell tower among them, a stone waterfront with little wooden boats, green mountains rising behind.

destinations.name: Isola Bella
destinations.prompt: A pure white peacock with its white tail fanned wide open, standing on a stone balustrade in the baroque terraced garden of Isola Bella on Lake Maggiore, the peacock large in the picture, clipped green hedges behind and the blue lake beyond.

destinations.name: Venice
destinations.prompt: An impressionist oil painting with lively broken brushstrokes: a quiet canal in Venice in soft morning light, a black gondola moored beside striped wooden poles, old palazzi with faded pink and ochre walls, arched windows and flower boxes rising straight from green water, a small stone footbridge in the distance. No famous landmarks.

destinations.name: Cinque Terre
destinations.prompt: Manarola in the Cinque Terre at golden hour: tall pastel houses in red, yellow, pink and peach stacked up a dark rocky sea cliff, little boats pulled up on the slipway at the bottom, the deep blue Ligurian Sea below. No boat names.

destinations.name: Burano
destinations.prompt: Burano near Venice: a row of small houses painted vivid blue, red, yellow, green and pink along a narrow canal, white window frames, little boats moored at the edge, the bright colours reflected in the still water.

destinations.name: The Cheese Cathedral
destinations.prompt: Inside a Parmigiano cheese ageing warehouse in Emilia: towering wooden shelves stacked to the ceiling with hundreds of big golden wheels of cheese in long receding rows, warm light. The rinds are plain, with no markings or writing.

destinations.name: Val d'Orcia
destinations.prompt: The Val d'Orcia in Tuscany: a pale road zigzagging up a green hill lined with rows of tall dark cypress trees, a stone farmhouse at the top, rolling green and golden hills around.

destinations.name: Civita di Bagnoregio
destinations.prompt: Civita di Bagnoregio in Lazio: a small medieval stone village perched on top of a steep crumbling clay pinnacle, reached by a long narrow footbridge rising from the foreground, deep eroded grey gullies and green valleys around, soft morning mist.

destinations.name: Monster Park
destinations.prompt: The Monster Park of Bomarzo: a giant moss-covered stone ogre head carved from a boulder, its huge gaping mouth a doorway you could walk into, wild staring eyes, among green woodland, large and filling the picture. No writing on it.

destinations.name: Positano
destinations.prompt: Positano on the Amalfi Coast: pastel houses in peach, pink and white tumbling down a steep cliff to a small beach with rows of orange umbrellas, the green-and-yellow tiled dome of its church among the houses, the deep blue sea.

destinations.name: The Faraglioni
destinations.prompt: The Faraglioni of Capri: three huge pale limestone sea stacks rising from deep blue water off a green cliff, the middle one pierced by a natural arch with a small white boat passing through it.

destinations.name: Matera
destinations.prompt: An oil painting: the Sassi of Matera at dusk, an ancient town of pale stone cave houses and small churches stacked up the side of a rocky ravine, warm lights in their windows, the deep ravine below, a blue evening sky.

destinations.name: Alberobello
destinations.prompt: The trulli of Alberobello in Puglia: rows of small whitewashed stone cottages with grey cone-shaped stone roofs topped with little white pinnacles, along a narrow lane climbing a hill, red geraniums in pots by the doors.

destinations.name: Bixby Bridge
destinations.prompt: Bixby Bridge on Big Sur in California: a soaring single arch of pale concrete with tall slender columns above it, spanning a deep canyon where it meets the Pacific, the coastal highway on top, green-gold cliffs and white surf below, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Emerald Bay
destinations.prompt: Emerald Bay on Lake Tahoe seen from the slopes above: a curving bay of brilliant green-blue water with tiny Fannette Island in the middle, ringed by steep pine-covered slopes, the deep blue lake beyond, grey granite mountains.

destinations.name: Mono Lake
destinations.prompt: The tufa towers of Mono Lake at sunrise: knobbly pale limestone towers rising from still lake water and mirrored in it, snowy Sierra Nevada mountains far behind, a pink and blue sky.

destinations.name: Joshua Tree
destinations.prompt: Joshua Tree National Park in California: one tall spiky Joshua tree with twisting arms in front of a pile of giant round tan granite boulders, the open desert floor, a pink sunset sky.

destinations.name: Oatman's Burros
destinations.prompt: A wild burro in Oatman, Arizona, an old Route 66 gold-rush town: a shaggy grey-brown burro with long ears standing in the dusty main street beside the wooden porch of an old false-front building, a second burro behind, dry hills under a blue sky. No signs or writing anywhere.

destinations.name: Horseshoe Bend
destinations.prompt: Horseshoe Bend in Arizona seen from the rim: the green Colorado River curving in a horseshoe loop around a tall red sandstone tower far below, sheer red cliffs, the pale rock rim in the foreground, late afternoon light.

destinations.name: Zion Narrows
destinations.prompt: The Narrows in Zion National Park, Utah: a shallow green river flowing between soaring sheer walls of red and orange sandstone only a few metres apart, glowing with reflected light, a strip of sky far above.

destinations.name: Bryce Canyon
destinations.prompt: Bryce Canyon in Utah: an amphitheatre of tall thin orange and pink rock spires (hoodoos) with pale tops, green pines on the rim, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Valley of Fire
destinations.prompt: The Fire Wave in Valley of Fire State Park, Nevada: a rounded dome of sandstone swirled with curving bands of pink, red and cream like a candy stripe, red rock fins around, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Grand Teton
destinations.prompt: Mormon Row in Grand Teton National Park, Wyoming: an old weathered grey wooden barn with a steep roof standing in a sagebrush meadow, the jagged snowy Teton peaks rising behind it, soft morning light.

destinations.name: Palouse Falls
destinations.prompt: Palouse Falls in Washington: a single waterfall plunging into a round turquoise pool in a deep bowl of dark basalt cliffs, golden grass on the rim, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Teapot Dome Station
destinations.prompt: The Teapot Dome Service Station in Zillah, Washington: a small 1920s gas station built in the shape of a giant white teapot with a red handle and spout and a round lid for its roof, an old petrol pump in front, under a blue sky. No writing anywhere.

destinations.name: Painted Hills
destinations.prompt: The Painted Hills in Oregon: soft rounded hills striped in bands of red, gold, ochre and black, sparse green shrubs at their feet, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Dog Bark Park Inn
destinations.prompt: Dog Bark Park Inn in Cottonwood, Idaho: a two-storey guesthouse built in the shape of a giant brown-and-cream beagle sitting on a green lawn, with windows in its body and a little balcony under its chin, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Crater Lake
destinations.prompt: Crater Lake in Oregon: a vast lake of deep sapphire blue filling a volcano's crater, ringed by steep grey cliffs, the cone of Wizard Island rising from the water near the edge, pines on the rim in the foreground, snow on the far rim.

destinations.name: The cliffs of Étretat
destinations.prompt: An impressionist oil painting with lively broken, dabbed brushstrokes: the Falaise d'Aval at Étretat in Normandy, tall white chalk cliffs topped with green grass, a great natural arch stepping out into the sea and a slender pointed needle of rock standing offshore beside it, a curving pebble beach, green-blue sea with small white waves, a breezy summer sky. Never a copy of a real painting.

destinations.name: Mont-Saint-Michel
destinations.prompt: Mont-Saint-Michel in Normandy at golden hour, seen from the flats: a granite rock island rising from wet, shining tidal sand, its ramparts and stone village houses climbing to the great Gothic abbey church on the summit with its tall slender spire topped by a small golden statue, a pale blue sky.

destinations.name: The pink granite coast
destinations.prompt: The pink granite coast at Ploumanac'h in Brittany: giant smooth rounded boulders of rose-pink granite piled along the shore, a small square lighthouse built of the same pink granite blocks among them, purple heather and yellow gorse, a calm blue-green sea, soft evening light.

destinations.name: The chapel oak of Allouville
destinations.prompt: The Chêne chapelle of Allouville-Bellefosse in Normandy: an enormous ancient hollow oak with a vast gnarled trunk, patched in places with grey wooden shingles, a small pointed shingled steeple rising from its top among the leafy branches, a wooden staircase with a handrail spiralling up around the trunk to a little door into the tree, a village lawn, summer light.

destinations.name: Château de Chenonceau
destinations.prompt: Château de Chenonceau in the Loire Valley: an elegant white stone Renaissance château with grey slate roofs and pointed turrets, its long gallery built right across the river Cher on a row of graceful arches, reflected in the calm water, green trees on both banks, a soft summer sky.

destinations.name: The Eiffel Tower
destinations.prompt: The Eiffel Tower in Paris on a bright sunny day, seen from the Champ de Mars: the whole tower from its four great arched legs to its slender tip, standing tall in the middle of the picture, its warm bronze-brown iron lattice crisp against a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, green lawns and trees at its feet. Daylight only, no lights.

destinations.name: Colmar's Little Venice
destinations.prompt: La Petite Venise in Colmar, Alsace: a row of tall half-timbered houses painted bright yellow, pink, blue and green with dark timber frames and red-brown tiled roofs, window boxes overflowing with red geraniums, leaning over a calm canal full of reflections, a small flat wooden boat moored under a willow. No shop signs or writing.

destinations.name: Mont Blanc from Lac Blanc
destinations.prompt: Lac Blanc above Chamonix on an early summer morning: a small still alpine lake among grey rocks and patches of snow, perfectly mirroring the snowy, jagged Mont Blanc massif across the valley, its glaciers and sharp needle peaks, a clear deep blue sky.

destinations.name: Palais Idéal du Facteur Cheval
destinations.prompt: Le Palais Idéal du Facteur Cheval in Hauterives, Drôme: a fantastical palace hand-built of cemented pebbles and stones, its façade crowded with sculpted towers, arches, grottoes, palm-trunk columns, animals and three tall stone giants, all in warm grey and ochre stone, a lawn and shrubs in front, a blue sky. No inscriptions or carved words.

destinations.name: The lavender of Valensole
destinations.prompt: The lavender fields of the Valensole plateau in Provence in July: long straight rows of purple lavender running into the distance towards a lone old stone farmhouse and a single round tree, a strip of golden wheat beyond, a soft blue sky.

destinations.name: The Gorges du Verdon
destinations.prompt: The Gorges du Verdon in Provence on a sunny day, seen from above: a deep limestone canyon with sheer pale cliffs and green scrub, a milky turquoise river winding along the bottom, a few small kayaks on the water.

destinations.name: The flamingos of the Camargue
destinations.prompt: Greater flamingos in a shallow lagoon of the Camargue in southern France: one pale pink flamingo close up wading in the foreground, dozens more pink flamingos standing and feeding in the calm silver-blue water behind it, reeds and a low flat horizon, soft morning light.

destinations.name: Carcassonne
destinations.prompt: La Cité de Carcassonne: the medieval walled city on its hill, double rings of honey-coloured stone ramparts and dozens of round towers with pointed grey slate cone roofs, rows of green vines in the foreground, a clear blue sky.

destinations.name: Bonifacio
destinations.prompt: Bonifacio in Corsica on a bright day: tall white and cream limestone cliffs worn into horizontal layers by the sea, the old town's tall houses perched right on the cliff edge high above a deep turquoise and blue sea, a small white boat far below.

destinations.name: The Dune du Pilat
destinations.prompt: The Dune du Pilat near Arcachon in late afternoon light: a vast golden sand dune with a sharp curving ridge, a dark green pine forest stretching away on one side and the blue Atlantic with pale sandbanks on the other, a few tiny walkers on the ridge.

destinations.name: Moraine Lake
destinations.prompt: Moraine Lake in Banff National Park: a vivid turquoise glacial lake below the Valley of the Ten Peaks, a wall of jagged grey mountain peaks streaked with snow, dark green spruce forest along the shore, a jumble of rocks in the foreground, a clear sky. No canoes.

destinations.name: Abraham Lake's frozen bubbles
destinations.prompt: Abraham Lake in Alberta in winter: stacks of round white bubbles frozen at different depths in clear dark blue-black ice, seen close up from above in the foreground, the frozen lake running away to snowy mountains in the distance, cold clear light.

destinations.name: The giant pysanka
destinations.prompt: The giant pysanka of Vegreville, Alberta: an enormous Ukrainian Easter egg sculpture on a tall pedestal, its surface built of flat bronze, gold and silver tiles in a geometric pattern of interlocking stars, triangles and stripes, a small grassy park around it, a big blue prairie sky. No text.

destinations.name: Mac the Moose
destinations.prompt: Mac the Moose in Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan: a giant ten-metre statue of a dark brown bull moose standing tall with a huge spread of pale antlers, on a grassy roadside park, seen from slightly below against a big blue prairie sky with white clouds. No text or signs.

destinations.name: The northern lights
destinations.prompt: The northern lights over Great Slave Lake near Yellowknife: bright green and violet aurora curtains swirling across a dark star-filled sky, above a snowy frozen lake and a dark line of spruce trees, drawn on dark blue paper.

destinations.name: Parliament Hill
destinations.prompt: Parliament Hill in Ottawa seen from across the Ottawa River on a sunny summer day: the Gothic Revival parliament buildings of pale sandstone with steep green copper roofs and the tall Peace Tower in the middle, standing along the top of a steep wooded cliff above the wide blue river, the buildings spread across the middle of the picture from left to right, a blue sky with white clouds. The clock face small, no readable numbers or writing.

destinations.name: The polar bears of Churchill
destinations.prompt: A polar bear on the shore of Hudson Bay near Churchill, Manitoba: a big cream-white polar bear standing on smooth grey rocks dusted with snow, close up, a second bear resting behind it, the first sea ice forming on the grey bay, soft overcast light. No vehicles.

destinations.name: Old Quebec in winter
destinations.prompt: An oil painting with confident brushwork: Old Quebec City at winter dusk, the Château Frontenac with its steep copper-green roofs, turrets and tall central tower rising above the snow-covered roofs of the old town, the icy St Lawrence River beside it, warm lights glowing in the windows, softly falling snow. No signs or writing.

destinations.name: Percé Rock
destinations.prompt: Percé Rock off the Gaspé Peninsula in Quebec on a sunny day: a huge long ship-shaped limestone rock rising sheer from the sea, pierced by a great natural arch at its seaward end, layered in ochre, orange and grey, the deep blue Gulf of St Lawrence around it, a pebble beach in the foreground.

destinations.name: The gannets of Bonaventure
destinations.prompt: Northern gannets on Bonaventure Island in Quebec: one white gannet close up in profile, its pale yellow head, pale blue-ringed eye and black wingtips, with thousands more gannets packed together on the cliff top behind it, the blue sea far below.

destinations.name: The Hopewell Rocks
destinations.prompt: The Hopewell Rocks in the Bay of Fundy at low tide: tall reddish-brown flowerpot sea stacks of eroded rock, narrow at the base and topped with small fir trees, standing on the wet sea floor, a few tiny people walking between them, the cliffs behind.

destinations.name: Peggy's Cove lighthouse
destinations.prompt: Peggy's Cove lighthouse in Nova Scotia: a white octagonal lighthouse with a red lantern room standing on smooth, rounded pale granite rocks, Atlantic waves breaking white below, a soft blue sky.

destinations.name: Lunenburg
destinations.prompt: The waterfront of Lunenburg, Nova Scotia: a row of big old wooden harbour warehouses painted bright barn red with white trim, and one ochre-yellow, along the wharf, mirrored in the calm harbour, the mast of a wooden schooner and small boats, the colourful town climbing the hill behind. No signs, names or writing.

destinations.name: The Cabot Trail in autumn
destinations.prompt: The Cabot Trail on Cape Breton Island in autumn: a winding road curving along a high coast through rolling hills blazing red, orange and gold with maples and birches, the deep blue sea beside it, a clear sky.

destinations.name: The icebergs of Twillingate
destinations.prompt: A huge iceberg drifting off Twillingate, Newfoundland on a bright clear day: a towering white iceberg with sculpted peaks and glowing blue cracks floating in a dark blue sea, a small fishing village of colourful wooden houses on the rocky shore in the foreground.

destinations.name: Iguazú Falls
destinations.prompt: Iguazú Falls on the Argentine side: the Devil's Throat, a vast horseshoe of roaring white and tawny waterfalls plunging into a cloud of mist, a rainbow in the spray, lush green jungle on the cliffs all around, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Caminito, La Boca
destinations.prompt: Caminito in La Boca, Buenos Aires: a short cobbled lane of old corrugated-iron houses painted in bright blocks of yellow, red, blue and green, with wooden balconies, shutters and potted plants, a sunny sky. No murals, statues, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Hill of Seven Colours
destinations.prompt: The Hill of Seven Colours above Purmamarca in Jujuy: a steep hill striped in bands of red, purple, green, ochre and cream rock, the small adobe village and tall cardón cacti at its foot, a deep blue Andean sky.

destinations.name: Iberá's capybaras
destinations.prompt: Capybaras in the Esteros del Iberá wetlands of Corrientes: a large capybara sitting calmly at the edge of the water among floating green plants, close up, more capybaras grazing behind on the marsh, soft morning light.

destinations.name: Mount Fitz Roy
destinations.prompt: Mount Fitz Roy in Patagonia at sunrise: a jagged wall of sheer granite spires glowing pink and orange, the tallest in the middle, glaciers at their feet, a snowy ridge and a green valley with southern beech trees in the foreground, a clear sky.

destinations.name: Les Éclaireurs lighthouse
destinations.prompt: Les Éclaireurs lighthouse in the Beagle Channel near Ushuaia: a small lighthouse painted in red and white bands with a black lantern, standing on a dark rocky islet with cormorants and sea lions, the whole lighthouse from its lantern to its rock tall in the middle of the picture, the cold blue channel around it, the snowy mountains of Tierra del Fuego behind.

destinations.name: La Trochita
destinations.prompt: An oil painting with confident brushwork: La Trochita, the Old Patagonian Express, a tiny black narrow-gauge steam locomotive with a tall chimney puffing white smoke, pulling small red wooden carriages across the golden Patagonian steppe, snowy mountains far behind, a wide blue sky. No names or writing.

destinations.name: Salinas Grandes
destinations.prompt: Salinas Grandes in Jujuy: a dazzling white salt flat cracked into hexagon tiles, long rectangular salt-harvesting pools of clear turquoise water cut into it in neat rows, distant brown mountains, a deep blue sky.

destinations.name: La Polvorilla viaduct
destinations.prompt: La Polvorilla viaduct in Salta: a curving steel railway viaduct on tall latticed trestles spanning a dry Andean ravine high in the mountains, a small red train crossing it, ochre and rust mountains, a deep blue sky. No writing.

destinations.name: A southern right whale
destinations.prompt: A southern right whale off the Valdés Peninsula: its huge black tail raised high out of the calm blue-green water of the Golfo Nuevo, water streaming from its edges, a pale cliff coast far behind, a soft blue sky.

destinations.name: The penguins of Punta Tombo
destinations.prompt: Magellanic penguins at Punta Tombo: one penguin close up with black and white bands across its chest, standing by its burrow in sandy scrubland, many more penguins waddling behind towards the blue sea.

destinations.name: The Arrayanes forest
destinations.prompt: The Arrayanes forest in Villa La Angostura: a grove of arrayán myrtle trees with smooth, twisting cinnamon-orange trunks mottled with white, a wooden boardwalk winding between them, green leaves above, soft light.

destinations.name: Ischigualasto's Mushroom
destinations.prompt: El Hongo, the Mushroom rock of Ischigualasto in San Juan: a tall rock shaped like a giant mushroom, a narrow eroded stem under a wide flat cap, standing alone in grey and pink badlands under a deep blue sky.

destinations.name: La Payunia
destinations.prompt: La Payunia in Mendoza: a vast field of black lava stretching to the horizon, dotted with rounded red and ochre volcanic cones, tufts of golden grass, a wide blue sky.

destinations.name: Perito Moreno Glacier
destinations.prompt: The Perito Moreno Glacier in Patagonia: a towering jagged wall of white and deep blue ice rising from milky turquoise water, a chunk of ice splashing into the water, the glacier stretching back between dark mountains, a clear sky.

destinations.name: The Twelve Apostles
destinations.prompt: The Twelve Apostles on the Great Ocean Road in Victoria at golden hour: tall limestone sea stacks standing in the surf below sheer golden cliffs, white waves foaming around their feet, a soft sky.

destinations.name: The Brighton bathing boxes
destinations.prompt: The bathing boxes of Brighton Beach in Melbourne: a row of little wooden beach boxes with pitched roofs, each painted one bright colour or simple stripes, on pale sand by blue water, a city skyline faint in the distance. No flags, pictures, numbers or writing on them.

destinations.name: Hutt Lagoon
destinations.prompt: Hutt Lagoon in Western Australia seen from the air: a vast bubblegum-pink salt lake beside a strip of white sand dunes and the deep blue Indian Ocean, the pink and the blue meeting in sharp edges.

destinations.name: Cape Hillsborough's kangaroos
destinations.prompt: Kangaroos on the beach at Cape Hillsborough in Queensland at sunrise: an eastern grey kangaroo standing upright on the wet sand close up, more kangaroos behind at the water's edge, the calm sea and a rocky headland glowing orange.

destinations.name: Whitehaven Beach
destinations.prompt: Whitehaven Beach and Hill Inlet in the Whitsundays seen from above: swirls of pure white silica sand curving through shallow turquoise and deep blue water, green forested hills at the edge.

destinations.name: The Sydney Harbour Bridge
destinations.prompt: The Sydney Harbour Bridge on a sunny day, seen from across the harbour: its great grey steel arch and stone pylons spanning the blue water from left to right across the middle of the picture, small ferries and sailboats below, a blue sky. No people on the arch, no flags, no lettering, and no other famous buildings.

destinations.name: The Bay of Fires
destinations.prompt: The Bay of Fires in Tasmania: big rounded granite boulders splashed with bright orange lichen on a white beach, clear turquoise water, a blue sky.

destinations.name: The Pinnacles Desert
destinations.prompt: The Pinnacles Desert in Nambung National Park: thousands of limestone spires of every size rising from golden-yellow sand, long shadows at sunset, a pale sky.

destinations.name: A Rottnest quokka
destinations.prompt: A quokka on Rottnest Island: a small round-eared brown quokka sitting up close to the camera with its cheerful face, on sandy ground with low green shrubs, a turquoise bay behind.

destinations.name: The Remarkable Rocks
destinations.prompt: The Remarkable Rocks on Kangaroo Island: huge wind-carved granite boulders hollowed into curving shells, caves and arches, perched on a bare granite dome above the blue Southern Ocean, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Cape Tribulation
destinations.prompt: Cape Tribulation in the Daintree: dense green rainforest running right down to a curving white beach, leaning coconut palms, the clear turquoise Coral Sea, a forested headland.

destinations.name: Karijini's gorges
destinations.prompt: An oil painting with confident brushwork: a gorge in Karijini National Park, walls of red and rust rock in thin flat layers, a narrow deep green pool at the bottom fed by a small waterfall, ferns at the edges, a slice of blue sky above.

destinations.name: The Big Banana
destinations.prompt: The Big Banana in Coffs Harbour: a giant yellow banana as long as a bus, with brown tips, lying on its side on a low base by the road, green hills of banana plants behind, a blue sky. No signs or writing.

destinations.name: Cradle Mountain
destinations.prompt: Cradle Mountain in Tasmania: the jagged double peak above Dove Lake, a small weathered wooden boatshed on the lake's pebble shore in front, golden buttongrass and green bushes, a blue sky with white clouds.

destinations.name: Heart Reef
destinations.prompt: Heart Reef in the Great Barrier Reef seen from the air: a small coral reef in a perfect heart shape, golden brown and green, ringed by pale turquoise shallows, in deep blue sea.

destinations.name: Table Mountain
destinations.prompt: Table Mountain seen across Table Bay from Bloubergstrand: the long, perfectly flat-topped grey mountain with the peak of Devil's Peak on its left and the cone of Lion's Head on its right, a thin white tablecloth of cloud spilling over its top, Cape Town small along its foot, the blue bay, and a sandy beach with low green dune plants in front, a clear sky. No cable car. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Bo-Kaap
destinations.prompt: The Bo-Kaap in Cape Town: a steep empty cobbled street of small old flat-roofed houses in a row, each painted one bright colour, pink, lime green, turquoise, yellow and violet, with white parapets, white window frames and low front steps, the green slope of Signal Hill behind, a blue sky. No people, no mosque, no signs, numbers or writing.

destinations.name: Oudtshoorn's ostriches
destinations.prompt: Ostriches near Oudtshoorn in the Little Karoo: an ostrich's head and long neck close up, peering curiously with big lashed eyes, more black-and-white ostriches behind on dry red earth, the rugged Swartberg mountains far behind under a blue sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Cape Winelands
destinations.prompt: An oil painting with confident brushwork: an old whitewashed Cape Dutch farmhouse with a tall curving gable and a thatched roof among rows of green vines in the Franschhoek valley, old oak trees beside it, rugged blue-grey mountains behind, a soft blue sky. No people, names or writing.

destinations.name: Cape Point
destinations.prompt: Cape Point at the tip of the Cape Peninsula: a high rocky headland of sheer sandstone cliffs plunging into the deep blue Atlantic, white surf at its foot, low green and ochre fynbos on its slopes, a small white lighthouse on its summit, a clear sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Drakensberg Amphitheatre
destinations.prompt: The Amphitheatre in the Drakensberg: a vast curved wall of sheer dark basalt cliffs running from the left edge to the right edge across the middle of the picture, the thin white ribbon of the Tugela Falls dropping from its rim, green grassy slopes and the Tugela valley below, a blue sky with white clouds. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Wolfberg Arch
destinations.prompt: The Wolfberg Arch in the Cederberg mountains: a huge free-standing orange sandstone arch weathered into ridges and hollows, standing on a rocky plateau, blue sky seen through it, rocky outcrops and low fynbos around, warm late light. No rock paintings. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Kalahari meerkats
destinations.prompt: Meerkats in the Kalahari: a meerkat standing upright on its hind legs on guard close up, two more standing beside it on a sandy mound, red Kalahari sand and dry golden grass, a blue sky.

destinations.name: Augrabies Falls
destinations.prompt: Augrabies Falls on the Orange River: a broad waterfall pouring in white and tawny streams over smooth grey granite into a deep, narrow granite gorge, mist rising, the dry rocky Northern Cape around, a blue sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Namaqualand in flower
destinations.prompt: Namaqualand in spring: a carpet of wild daisies in bright orange, yellow and white covering gentle semi-desert hills, a few rounded granite boulders, the flowers close in front facing the sun, a blue sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Bourke's Luck Potholes
destinations.prompt: Bourke's Luck Potholes in Mpumalanga: deep round potholes carved by swirling water into banded yellow, orange and rusty red rock, dark green pools at their bottoms, the river cascading between them, green bush at the edges. No bridges, rails or people.

destinations.name: Kruger's elephants
destinations.prompt: Elephants in the Kruger National Park: an African elephant mother and her small calf drinking at a waterhole close up, more elephants behind, dry golden bush and a few flat-topped acacia trees, warm afternoon light. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Sani Pass
destinations.prompt: Sani Pass: a gravel road zigzagging in tight hairpin bends up the steep green wall of the Drakensberg escarpment, one small plain four-wheel-drive car climbing it, a mountain stream below, a blue sky with white clouds. No text or logos.

destinations.name: St Lucia's town hippos
destinations.prompt: A hippo in St Lucia, a little holiday town in KwaZulu-Natal, at dusk: a large hippopotamus calmly grazing on a neat green front lawn beside a quiet town road, a low house with a thatched roof and palm trees behind, soft pink and blue evening light. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Three Rondavels
destinations.prompt: The Three Rondavels above the Blyde River Canyon: three round, steep-sided rock peaks with green grassy tops, shaped like round huts, standing in a row, banded orange and grey cliffs below them, the deep green canyon and the blue water of the Blyde Dam far below, a blue sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Palace of Westminster
destinations.prompt: The Palace of Westminster in London on a bright day, seen from across the River Thames: the long golden-grey Gothic palace along the river with its many pinnacles, the tall clock tower with its gold and blue clock face at the right end, the square Victoria Tower far to the left, the river in front. No flags, emblems, crests, buses, people or writing, and no big wheel.

destinations.name: The Royal Crescent
destinations.prompt: The Royal Crescent in Bath: a grand sweeping curve of honey-coloured Georgian stone houses joined in one terrace, with rows of tall columns, seen across a wide green lawn, a few trees, a blue sky with white clouds. No people, text or writing.

destinations.name: Stonehenge
destinations.prompt: Stonehenge on Salisbury Plain at sunrise, seen from outside the circle: the great grey sarsen stones and trilithons with their lintels, and a few fallen stones, standing in green grass, a golden sun low behind them, a pale sky with soft clouds. No people, fences, paths or ropes.

destinations.name: Durdle Door
destinations.prompt: Durdle Door on the Jurassic Coast in Dorset: a natural limestone arch reaching out from the cliffs into the clear turquoise sea, a curving pale shingle beach beside it, the green clifftop above, a blue sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Pontcysyllte Aqueduct
destinations.prompt: The Pontcysyllte Aqueduct in Wales: a narrow iron canal trough carried high across the green Dee valley on tall slender stone pillars, a long red and green narrowboat crossing on the water at the top, the river and trees far below, a blue sky with white clouds. No names or writing on the boat, no people.

destinations.name: The Dark Hedges
destinations.prompt: The Dark Hedges in County Antrim: an avenue of old beech trees with twisted grey trunks and branches arching over a narrow country road like a tunnel, the road running straight away from the viewer up the middle of the picture, the trunks from the road to the treetops tall in the middle, soft green light and a little mist. No people, cars or signs.

destinations.name: The Giant's Causeway
destinations.prompt: The Giant's Causeway in County Antrim: thousands of hexagonal basalt columns of different heights like stepping stones of dark grey rock, close in front and running out into the sea, waves breaking around them, green cliffs behind, a soft bright sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Connemara's painted sheep
destinations.prompt: Sheep in Connemara: a woolly black-faced sheep with a splash of blue dye on its back standing in the middle of a narrow country road, looking at the camera, more sheep with pink and blue dye marks behind, dry stone walls, green bog and brown-purple mountains, a cloudy sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Cliffs of Moher
destinations.prompt: The Cliffs of Moher in County Clare: sheer dark layered cliffs over 200 metres tall curving away along the coast, green grass along their tops, a tall sea stack at their foot, Atlantic waves breaking white far below, a bright sky with clouds. No buildings, fences or people.

destinations.name: The doors of Dublin
destinations.prompt: An oil painting with confident brushwork: Georgian front doors in a red brick terrace in Dublin, each painted a different bright colour, red, yellow, blue and green, each with a half-round glass fanlight above, brass knockers, white columns at the sides and stone steps. No numbers, plaques, people or writing.

destinations.name: A Highland cow
destinations.prompt: A Highland cow in Glencoe: a shaggy ginger Highland cow with a long fringe hanging over its eyes and wide curving horns close up, standing in rough grass, the steep green and grey mountains of Glencoe behind under a moody sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: The Fairy Pools
destinations.prompt: The Fairy Pools on the Isle of Skye: a small waterfall pouring into a clear turquoise-blue pool in grey rock, the stream stepping down in little falls, the jagged dark Black Cuillin mountains behind, green moorland, a cloudy sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Keem Bay
destinations.prompt: Keem Bay on Achill Island: a small horseshoe bay of pale sand and turquoise water tucked between steep green hills that drop to the sea, seen from the road above, a soft sky. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Loch Ness and Urquhart Castle
destinations.prompt: Urquhart Castle on Loch Ness: the ruined grey stone castle and its square tower on a green point above the dark loch, wooded hills on the far side, and out in the still water a long dark neck and three rounded humps in a row, half in the mist, like the old legend. Soft grey morning light. No people, signs or writing.

destinations.name: Edinburgh Castle
destinations.prompt: Edinburgh Castle high on its volcanic rock above the city: grey stone walls, the curved half-moon battery and the buildings along the summit, the sheer black crag below, the green trees of Princes Street Gardens at its foot, a blue sky. No flags, crests, people or writing.
